title: Projects
text:
Currently, I am writing my master’s thesis about fairness in clinical prediction models. I write the thesis under the supervision of Anne De Hond and Maarten Van Smeden at the Department of Biostatistics and Data Science at the University Medical Center Utrecht.





I am doing an research internship at the Methodology, Statistics and Data Science Department at Utrecht University where I work together with Alfons Edmar and Irene Klugkist on Effect Size Harmonization in Bayesian Evidence Synthesis.

title: Projects
text:
The Effect of Resampling Methods as a Fairness Mitigation Strategy on the Performance of Prediction Models Across Different Subgroups
Currently, I am working on my Master’s thesis, which I write at Biostatistics and Data Science Department of the University Medical Center in Utrecht.

title: Projects
text:
Currently, I am working on a simulation study about fairness in clinical prediction models. I am writing my master’s thesis at the Department of Biostatistics and Data Science at the University Medical Center Utrecht, under the supervision of Anne De Hond and Maarten Van Smeden.





I am doing an research internship at the Methodology, Statistics and Data Science Department at Utrecht University where I work together with Alfons Edmar and Irene Klugkist on Effect Size Harmonization in Bayesian Evidence Synthesis.

title: Projects
text:
Completed Projects

Analysis of Sex-Specific Differences in Load-Velocity Profiles in Front Crawl Swimming

I wrote my bachelor’s thesis under the supervision of Sebastian Keller and Tinka Smolarek, who both work in the Department of Performance Physiology, German Sport University View my Bachelorthesis



Effect Size Calculation Procedures in Exercise Intervention Meta-Analyses: A Scoping Review

I co-authored a review on effect size calculation in exercise meta-analyses together with colleagues from the German Sport University Cologne. (Nolte et al. 2026)
